verses.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת הַבֹּטְחִ֥ים בַּיהוָ֑ה כְּֽהַר־ צִיּ֥וֹן לֹא־ יִ֝מּ֗וֹט לְעוֹלָ֥ם יֵשֵֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: šîr ham·ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ hab·bō·ṭə·ḥîm Yah·weh kə·har- ṣî·yō·wn lō- yim·mō·wṭ lə·‘ō·w·lām yê·šêḇ
verses.literal: A song of ascents Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion It cannot be moved it abides forever

verses.original: יְֽרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם הָרִים֮ סָבִ֪יב לָ֥הּ וַ֭יהוָה סָבִ֣יב לְעַמּ֑וֹ מֵ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yə·rū·šā·lim hā·rîm sā·ḇîḇ lāh Yah·weh sā·ḇîḇ lə·‘am·mōw mê·‘at·tāh wə·‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: As the mountains surround Jerusalem so the LORD surrounds His people both now and forevermore . . .

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֪א יָנ֡וּחַ שֵׁ֤בֶט הָרֶ֗שַׁע עַל֮ גּוֹרַ֪ל הַֽצַּדִּ֫יקִ֥ים לְמַ֡עַן לֹא־ יִשְׁלְח֖וּ הַצַּדִּיקִ֨ים בְּעַוְלָ֬תָה יְדֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî lō yā·nū·aḥ šê·ḇeṭ hā·re·ša‘ ‘al gō·w·ral haṣ·ṣad·dî·qîm lə·ma·‘an lō- yiš·lə·ḥū haṣ·ṣad·dî·qîm bə·‘aw·lā·ṯāh yə·ḏê·hem
verses.literal: For the scepter of the wicked will not rest upon the land allotted to the righteous so that the righteous will not put forth their hands to injustice
Do good O LORD to those who are good and to the upright in heart

verses.original: וְהַמַּטִּ֤ים עַֽקַלְקַלּוֹתָ֗ם יוֹלִיכֵ֣ם יְ֭הוָה אֶת־ פֹּעֲלֵ֣י הָאָ֑וֶן שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ham·maṭ·ṭîm ‘a·qal·qal·lō·w·ṯām yō·w·lî·ḵêm Yah·weh ’eṯ- pō·‘ă·lê hā·’ā·wen šā·lôm ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: But those who turn to crooked ways the LORD . . . will banish with the evildoers . . . Peace be upon Israel
